variants.query_and_update: At current s=(z,v,x), define phi_G=(grad_1 G_i, G_11,i v, G_21,i v) and phi_F=(grad_1 F_j,grad_2 F_j). For every quantity phi maintain old tables phi_i(w_i) and their mean. Draw independent uniform i,j. Use S_G(phi)=phi_i(s)-phi_i(w_i)+mean_l phi_l(w_l), and analogously S_F. Set Dz=S_G(grad_1 G), Dv=S_G(G_11 v)+S_F(grad_1 F), Dx=S_G(G_21 v)+S_F(grad_2 F). Form directions using old means, then replace the sampled table entries by their values at s and update means. Simultaneously zplus=z-rho_t Dz, vplus=v-rho_t Dv, xplus=x-gamma_t Dx; all directions use the old s.
variants.requirements: F C1, G C2, G(.,x) uniformly strongly convex and minimizer exists; implicit differentiation valid. Finite sums F=m^{-1}sum F_j, G=n^{-1}sum G_i for algorithm variants.; Component gradients, inner HVPs and mixed-Jacobian-vector products. Can query same component at current and stored states.
variants.state_and_initialization: z0,v0,x0 arbitrary. For SABA initialize all sample memories at s0 and evaluate the five tables; do not omit O(n+m) component initialization.
variants.tuning_and_stopping: Positive rho_t,gamma_t supplied; convergence-certified choices require the full assumptions and constants in Section3 and supplementary AppendixC, not extracted here.
